title: Ceylon Chamber urges talks over proposed US tariff on Sri Lankan exports
summary: Ceylon Chamber of Commerce has urged the government to hold high-level discussions with the United States over a proposed 12.5% labour-related tariff on Sri Lankan exports.
description: Ceylon Chamber of Commerce has urged the government to hold high-level discussions with the United States over a proposed 12.5% labour-related tariff on Sri Lankan exports.

title: Sri Lanka launches disaster resilience roadmap for 2026–2030
summary: The “Sri Lanka National Anticipatory Action Roadmap 2026–2030” was launched today (June 4) in Colombo to strengthen disaster preparedness and climate resilience through proactive measures.

title: Amber advisory issued for strong winds
summary: The Department of Meteorology has issued an Amber advisory for strong winds affecting the Central, Sabaragamuwa, Northern and North Central provinces, and the Trincomalee and Hambantota districts.
